- [GK-BPHS36] Gajakesari, strict: Jupiter in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon, joined or aspected by a benefic, not debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign: HOLDS. kendra from lagna yes, from Moon no; benefic contact Ve; debilitated no; enemy's sign no; combust no.
